title: Disagreeing reviewers
statementMd:
Find pairs of reviewers who rated the same movie with a difference of at least 3 points. Show movie title, the two reviewers (alphabetical order within the pair) and the difference.

Expected columns: `title`, `reviewer_a`, `reviewer_b`, `diff`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.title, a.reviewer AS reviewer_a, b.reviewer AS reviewer_b, ABS(a.rating - b.rating) AS diff FROM reviews a JOIN reviews b ON a.movie_id = b.movie_id AND a.reviewer < b.reviewer JOIN movies m ON m.id = a.movie_id WHERE ABS(a.rating - b.rating) >= 3;
```
